topography.project_purpose: Structural profile: 11 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 1 ERC20 token, 1 ERC721 NFT; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 4 functional families. Its contracts share 2 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, erc1967upgrade). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
